# Hackernoon

A launch platform: listings get a day (or week) in the spotlight, so timing and the first comment matter.

Notes from the directory list: Write a launch/story post; strong SEO + distribution.

## Steps
1. Open https://hackernoon.com/ and read the rules (sidebar, wiki, FAQ or guidelines).
2. Write a post for this specific audience from `copy.reddit_post` / `copy.launch_post_story`, following skill/human-writing.
3. `launchkit draft hackernoon -` with title, body, flair and best posting time, then `launchkit mark hackernoon drafted`.
4. Only if `launch_settings.allow_social_posting` is true and the user approved this draft: post it, then mark `submitted --listing-url <post url>`.

## Make the listing perform
- Pick the earliest free launch slot on or after the user's preferred launch date. Never pay to skip the queue unless the user approved it.
- Use `copy.maker_comment` as the first comment. Reply to every comment on launch day (tell the user).
- Use the best screenshot first. The thumbnail decides whether people click.
